name: task_create
description: Create a new task in z-task (project collaboration platform). The task is persisted in MySQL table z_task_task. Backed by POST /api/task. The caller is automatically set as the task creator (from z-ctc SSO user). Use this when the CEO agent needs to convert an opportunity into an actionable task, log a follow-up, or create a checklist item. Returns the new Task object including the assigned numeric id. Note: requires the caller to be authenticated via z-ctc SSO.

title.description: Task title. Concise, action-oriented, e.g. 'Refactor user-service to use z-mist for DB password'.

description.description: Markdown-formatted task body. May include acceptance criteria, links to spec, related opportunity id (e.g. 'OPP-001').

projectId.description: Numeric project id. Required. Use ProjectController GET /api/task/project/list to discover available projects.

boardId.description: Board id within the project. Default 1 if omitted.

listId.description: Initial list/column id (e.g. 'To Do', 'In Progress'). Required. Use TaskListController to discover available lists for the board.

dueDate.description: Optional ISO 8601 date, e.g. '2026-07-01'. Mapped to DB column 'deadline' (DATETIME).

position.description: Optional sort position within the list. Lower = top. Default: appended to end.
